llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam indicators: it promises unrealistic and guaranteed returns (up to 80% ROI), uses urgent psychological triggers, and provides neither verifiable company information nor evidence of regulatory oversight. It encourages deposits via vague payment methods ('any crypto wallet'), offers instant withdrawals (rarely true for real trading platforms), and provides ambiguous privacy/data statements. The domain was registered very recently (April 2025) and is tied to a registrant in Nigeria with a generic Gmail address and no credible organization details. Multiple scam characteristics are present, strongly supporting this conclusion.
